facts.name: Charles L.W. Helm
facts.assignment: Administrative Judge for Sumter County; circuit assignments: felony, juvenile delinquency and Jimmy Ryce cases under S-2025-58-A, effective June29,2026. Primarily noncommercial; basic operating review only.

contact.contact_note: Office/assistant shared telephone; separate personal judicial email and fax not established.

hearing_scheduling.summary: File motion first; email assistant and opposing counsel with motion copy, case number and requested time. File notice with motion docket number only after office confirms date/time. Cancellation requires court approval.

proposed_orders.summary: Email .docx orders only to dedicated order-submission address, with motion and cover letter identifying hearing and agreement status. Use case style/number in subject and required service language; consult profile for formatting details.

remote_appearances.summary: Hearings ordinarily in person, Courtroom D. Telephone/Zoom needs written motion and a hearing at least fifteen days before requested appearance for authorization.

chambers_communications.summary: Copy opposing counsel on all correspondence; allow48hours for response. Do not contact judge directly about pending case merits.

conferral.summary: No separate general conferral rule established in bounded profile review.

courtesy_copies.summary: Motion copy accompanies hearing request and proposed order; separate general courtesy-copy policy not established.

facts.summary: Email-coordinated hearings, in-person Courtroom D default and Word orders through dedicated mailbox. Basic noncommercial operating review.

review_scope.collected: Complete official profile HTML/text and three-page assignment order with extracted text and page1 rendering.
review_scope.content_reviewed: Profile contacts/basic office operations; assignment order page1 Helm assignment/effective date visually checked and page3 issuance date extracted.
review_scope.not_reviewed: Criminal or commitment litigation substance; linked rule compilations not fetched. Other judges in assignment order await individual review.

gaps: No fax, separate assistant-only telephone or personal judicial email established on official roster/profile.

citations.locator: Contacts and basic scheduling, submissions, appearances and communication sections
Page1 effective circuit assignment June29,2026 and sectionI; page3 issuance date. Other assignments collected for subsequent reviews.
